poolNote: Encounter-pool record for this evolution family. Wild forms vary by level, mode and area; this does not guarantee the selected form.
extraCondition: Additional evolution conditions apply; this early version has no complete text description.
noRelations: This form has no preceding or subsequent evolution.
unseenRelation: This form has not been seen; its detailed records are unavailable.
pokeball: Have at least one regular Poké Ball
seededChance: Fixed individual seed, 1/{{denominator}} of outcomes; browsing does not reroll it
unreachableRockruff: Requires default form index 1. This version returns 0 for Rockruff, so this branch cannot be satisfied
battleTrigger: Triggered by the current ability or battle flow
ordinaryForm: Ordinary/cosmetic form; no additional trigger record in the current form-change table
previewOnly: Preview only: no transformation, unlock or party change
noForms: This species has no other forms
branchOrder: Level-up evolutions are checked in table order; an earlier eligible branch takes priority
shedinjaExtra: Shedinja is created additionally when Nincada evolves into Ninjask
